location.section: Rooted — Claude Code plugins rooted in evidence (intro bullets)

patches.current: For example, instead of an `/init`-style project-structure blob in `CLAUDE.md` (a file class shown not to improve success while raising inference cost 20–23%, with repository overviews specifically found unhelpful [[15]](#references)), orientation happens on demand via [`overview.sh`](overview.sh) with an explicit stop-instruction.
patches.justification: The `/init`-style blob is named as the foil of the orientation decision ("instead of"), not as the subject of a present-tense environmental fact that blocks it; rewrite as the blocking fact (for example, what a static structure blob does to cost and success today) followed by the on-demand `overview.sh` approach, or drop the comparison.

patches.current: v5 retitle of *Configuring Agentic AI Coding Tools*
patches.justification: "retitle of" parses only against an earlier title of the paper; the surviving present facts are the title and the 2,853-repo sample, and the version tag plus former title can go or be moved to the provenance map.

patches.current: A record is required on every rule line that is added or changed; the lines not yet touched carry their sources without a record.
patches.justification: "not yet touched" depends on a prior state; stripped of it a self-standing contract survives (a record is required on every added or changed rule line), so the verdict is rewrite in present tense, not delete.
